mint ERC-1155 id 2 ×50 to the wallet

owner 1 proposes 1 GMB to the recipient
ONE owner alone cannot execute it
it cannot be executed a second time
ONE owner alone cannot send USDT
USDT moves — a token whose transfer returns NOTHING
250 USDT arrived (SafeERC20 handled the missing return value)
ONE owner alone cannot send the NFT

ONE owner alone cannot send the 1155

ONE owner alone cannot send the batch

the batch executes in ONE transaction
two ERC-721 and two ERC-1155 positions all delivered
an EOA that is not an owner cannot propose
owner 1 proposes 1 LIE (a token whose transfer returns false)
nothing left the wallet and no success event was emitted
the failed send did not burn the two owners' approval
owner 2 proposes 0.5 GMB to a contract that refuses money
the send fails loudly with NativeTransferFailed
the recipient contract is told to start accepting
the SAME approval now works — nothing had to be re-approved
0.5 GMB delivered once the obstacle was removed
block the recipient on USDC (as Circle can)
a blocklisted recipient reverts the transfer
a paused token blocks the send
turn on USDT's fee-on-transfer (10 bp, cap 5)
the recipient netted 99.9 USDT after the 0.1 fee — the wallet coped
owner 1 proposes 0.4 GMB to the attacker contract
arm the attacker to re-enter on receipt
execute: the attacker is paid AND tries to re-enter
the re-entry was REFUSED by the guard
send it a little gas so it can accept
it was scheduled, not made immediately executable
the newcomer cannot accept on one approval
nobody can accept on the newcomer's behalf
the newcomer accepts, from its own address
🔴 two approvals and an acceptance are STILL not enough — the delay must run
isExecutable reports false while it matures
🔴 owner 3 — the one being removed — vetoes it alone
and it can never execute, however long one waits
a plain transfer cannot be vetoed — one owner still cannot block the other two
owner 1 proposes, then revokes its own approval
owner 1 proposes again and owner 2 confirms
now the proposer alone cannot pull it back
a lifetime below MIN_TTL is refused
the zero address is refused as recipient
the wallet itself is refused as recipient
seating an existing owner is refused
depositNative from the deployer (not an owner)
depositERC20 — the event names WHO deposited
100 USDT arrived through the accounted path
switch USDT's fee back on (10 bp, cap 5)
depositERC20 of 100 against a fee-charging token
🔴 the event reports what ARRIVED, not what was requested
approve the wallet for all of the collection
the NFT is in the wallet
mint ERC-1155 id 90 ×10 to the deployer
approve the wallet for the 1155 collection
mint ERC-1155 id 91 ×8 to the deployer
mint ERC-1155 id 92 ×6 to the deployer
depositNFTBatch — four items, both standards, one transaction
the whole batch was pulled in
an empty deposit batch is refused
not timelocked — allowlisting a token grants no ability to steal
a single owner cannot veto it
the list reads back with the owner-supplied label
the history keeps the entry, it is just not allowed
🔴 it needs all three owners, not two
the label is stored with the proposal
owner 2 confirms — that is two of three
🔴 TWO owners cannot push it through
and the state says why: 2 of 3 approvals against a requirement of 3, not executable
owner 3 confirms — now all three agree
🔴 and even unanimous, the delay must still run
a SECOND proposal is left pending on purpose
owner 3 confirms — unanimous, just waiting on the clock
left pending so the timelock can be observed maturing on the real chain
owner 1 proposes switching BOTH requirements ON
🔴 with the recipient requirement on, an unlisted destination is refused
and an unlisted token is refused too
owner 1 proposes switching them back OFF
🔴 loosening IS timelocked — an attacker cannot just switch the control off
a delay below the floor is refused
a delay above the ceiling is refused
a policy proposal that changes nothing is refused
a LONGER delay is accepted and applies at once
both requirements are live from the constructor
the seeded cold address is active immediately
both seeded tokens are active immediately
a transfer to the seeded cold address — the escape hatch
it goes through on two of three, as always
0.4 GMB delivered to the cold address
🔴 but ANY other destination is refused outright
a listed token to the listed destination works
1 · they cannot send to their own address
2 · they propose allowlisting an attacker address
two keys cannot reach the unanimous threshold
even if the third were tricked into confirming
🔴 the honest owner vetoes it alone
and the address is never allowlisted
3 · they propose switching the requirement off
🔴 the honest owner vetoes that too
4 · they propose taking the honest owner's seat
